title: Q-TENANT-MIGRATE-1: move QNFO high-read tables off scans (steps M1 to M6 in doctrine/tenant-storage.json)
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** executor tick, driver order
**Done check:** file:ops/tenant-storage/top-queries.json
**Status:** closed

TENANT-STORAGE-1. Work the steps M1 to M6 in order; each step's probe is in doctrine/tenant-storage.json. Free-plan daily read limit took /ops down 2026-11-16; qnfo-audit read 29.0 B rows in 30 days.
Paths: doctrine/tenant-storage.json, workers core/tenantstore.
Acceptance: M1 list exists, then rows read per day on qnfo-audit stays under 5 M for 3 days.

size: L

**Closing probe:** file:ops/tenant-storage/top-queries.json exists and python3 -m foundation tenantstorage --check passes.

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-21T18:12:26Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 126.2 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
